Download **bambu-deck-0.1.11.streamDeckPlugin** and double-click it; Stream Deck installs the plugin along with its profiles.

- New key "AMS-Gerät": the whole AMS on one key, drawn as on the design canvas (AMS, AMS lite, AMS 2 Pro, AMS HT) with the real spool colours. The spool in use turns, empty slots are dashed, a nearly empty spool gets a honey dot, drying shows heat and the time left
- Printer drawings per model (X1/X2D, P1/P2S, A1/A2L, H2/H3C) on "Steuern", "Druckinfo" and in the setup guide
- AMS humidity: a filled drop when it is too humid, the drying temperature on top while drying
- Starter profiles show the AMS unit key instead of the humidity key
